name: TherapyFuel
description: TherapyFuel is TherapyNotes' native AI scribe add-on at $40/clinician/month. Similar to SimplePractice Note Taker, it only works within its parent EHR—TherapyNotes users get seamless integration, but non-users cannot access it standalone. TherapyFuel Scribe captures in-person and telehealth sessions, generates complete transcripts, and auto-populates documentation. Key differentiator: Clinical Voice Settings allow extensive personalization (tone, formality, note length, language). Audio is encrypted, transcribed, and deleted immediately. Current limitations: no group therapy support, no intake or psychiatry notes (coming soon), and no external audio upload. Realistic cost: TherapyNotes Solo ($59/mo) + TherapyFuel ($40/mo) = $99/month total.

faqs.q: How much does TherapyFuel cost in 2026?
faqs.a: TherapyFuel costs $40/clinician/month as an add-on to TherapyNotes. Realistic total cost: TherapyNotes Solo ($59/mo) + TherapyFuel ($40/mo) = $99/month. If one clinician subscribes, everyone in the practice gets free access to Client History Summaries and Contact Note generation.

faqs.q: Can I use TherapyFuel without TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: No. TherapyFuel is exclusively available to TherapyNotes users. It's a native add-on, not a standalone product. If you're not on TherapyNotes, consider Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo) which work with any EHR.

faqs.q: Does TherapyFuel support group therapy sessions?
faqs.a: No, not yet. TherapyFuel currently only supports individual therapy sessions—both telehealth and in-person. Group therapy support is not available as of 2026.

Partially. TherapyFuel can transcribe psychiatric sessions, but intake notes and psychiatry-specific documentation (medication management, MSE) are listed as 'coming soon' and not yet available. Psychiatrists should consider Freed ($39-119/mo) or mdhub instead.

faqs.q: TherapyFuel vs SimplePractice Note Taker: which is better?
faqs.a: Both are native AI scribes locked to their parent EHRs. TherapyFuel ($40/mo) offers Clinical Voice Settings for personalization. SimplePractice Note Taker ($35/mo) supports in-person via mobile. Choose based on which EHR you use—switching is difficult with either.
